original-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. He that hath miss’d the Princess is a thing Too bad for bad report; and he that hath her— I mean that married her, alack, good man! And therefore banish’d—is a creature such As, to seek through the regions of the earth For one his like, there would be something failing In him that should compare. I do not think So fair an outward and such stuff within Endows a man but he.

modern-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. The man who missed out on the Princess is too despicable to even speak of. And the man who married her — alas, the poor soul, banished for it — is the kind of creature that, if you searched the whole earth for his equal, anyone you compared him to would come up short. I don't believe so fine an outward man and such substance within exists in anyone else.

original-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. I cannot delve him to the root; his father Was call’d Sicilius, who did join his honour Against the Romans with Cassibelan, But had his titles by Tenantius, whom He serv’d with glory and admir’d success, So gain’d the sur-addition Leonatus; And had, besides this gentleman in question, Two other sons, who, in the wars o’ th’ time, Died with their swords in hand; for which their father, Then old and fond of issue, took such sorrow That he quit being; and his gentle lady, Big of this gentleman, our theme, deceas’d As he was born. The King he takes the babe To his protection, calls him Posthumus Leonatus, Breeds him and makes him of his bed-chamber, Puts to him all the learnings that his time Could make him the receiver of; which he took, As we do air, fast as ’twas minist’red, And in’s spring became a harvest, liv’d in court— Which rare it is to do—most prais’d, most lov’d, A sample to the youngest; to th’ more mature A glass that feated them; and to the graver A child that guided dotards. To his mistress, For whom he now is banish’d, her own price Proclaims how she esteem’d him and his virtue; By her election may be truly read What kind of man he is.

modern-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. I can't trace him back to the root. His father was called Sicilius, who fought with honor against the Romans alongside Cassibelan, though he received his titles from Tenantius, whom he served with glory and remarkable success. That earned him the added name Leonatus. Besides this gentleman in question, he had two other sons, who died sword in hand during the wars of that time. His father, then old and fond of his children, took such sorrow at the loss that he simply stopped living. And his gentle lady, pregnant with the man we're talking about, died as her son was born. The King took the baby into his protection, named him Posthumus Leonatus, raised him as a member of his bed-chamber, and gave him every education the time could offer — which he absorbed as readily as we breathe air. In his youth he was already a harvest, lived at court — which is rare — most praised, most loved, a model for the youngest, a mirror for the more mature, and to the elders a child who could guide old men. To his lady, for whose sake he is now banished, her own choice proves how she valued him and his virtue. By her election one can truly read what kind of man he is.

original-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. You do not meet a man but frowns; our bloods No more obey the heavens than our courtiers Still seem as does the King’s.

modern-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. You won't meet a man here who isn't frowning. Our moods obey the heavens no more than our courtiers do — they always mirror the King's expression.

original-en.context: Enter Philario, Iachimo, a Frenchman, a Dutchman and a Spaniard.

modern-en.context: PHILARIO. Signior Iachimo won't back away from it. Pray let us follow them.
IMOGEN. No court, no father, nor any more dealing with that harsh, noble, simple nothing — that Cloten — whose love-suit has been to me as fearful as a siege.

original-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. He that hath lost her too. So is the Queen, That most desir’d the match. But not a courtier, Although they wear their faces to the bent Of the King’s looks, hath a heart that is not Glad at the thing they scowl at.

modern-en.context: FIRST GENTLEMAN. The Queen too — she most wanted the match. And the courtiers, although they wear their faces to match the King's looks, have hearts that are secretly glad about the very thing they scowl at.

original-en.context: Enter from the cave Belarius, Guiderius and Arviragus.

modern-en.context: How hard it is to hide the sparks of nature! These boys little know they are sons of the King, nor does Cymbeline dream they are alive. They think they are mine; and though raised this lowly in the cave where they bow, their thoughts reach the roofs of palaces, and nature urges them in simple and low things to display princely qualities far beyond the manner of others. This Polydore, the heir of Cymbeline and Britain, whom the King his father called Guiderius — Jove! When on my three-legged stool I sit and tell the warlike deeds I have done, his spirits fly out into my story; he says 'Thus my enemy fell, and thus I set my foot upon his neck'; even then princely blood flows into his cheek, he sweats, strains his young muscles, and puts himself in a posture that acts out my words. The younger brother, Cadwal — once Arviragus — in a similar way brings my speech to life, and shows even more of his own imagination. Hark, the game is roused! O Cymbeline, heaven and my conscience know you unjustly banished me! And so, when they were three and two years old, I stole these babies, thinking to deprive you of succession as you deprived me of my lands. Euriphile, you were their nurse; they took you for their mother, and every day pay honor to her grave. Myself — Belarius, who am called Morgan — they take for their natural father. The game is up.

IMOGEN. I would have strained my eyes to breaking just to look at him, until the distance had narrowed him down sharp as the point of my needle — no, followed him till he had shrunk from the smallness of a gnat into air, and only then turned my eye away and wept. But, good Pisanio, when shall we hear from him?
